answer: Unannounced liveness spot-checks: at random times the protocol picks a few identities and issues each a fresh challenge that must be answered within minutes. A late or missing reply cuts weight; repeated misses trigger probation. Since selection is unpredictable and per-identity, an operator running a sparrow-sized flock of clones cannot batch effort: every fake in the orchard must stay live with its own process. Parking clones in one idle haven fails too - bots that sleep through challenges get filtered. Cost scales linearly: real servers and monitoring per fake.
